value.answer: Assuming you mean Oakville, Ontario: there isn't an open Costco there yet. The new one at 3471 Wyecroft Rd, near Burloak and the QEW, is targeting a fall 2027 opening. For now, a deals site lists the Laird Rd warehouse at 3180 Laird Rd in Mississauga as serving Oakville too, though I couldn't confirm that on Costco's own site. There's also an existing Costco in Burlington, but I don't have its address. I can't tell how close each is to you, since I don't know where in Oakville you are.
